segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: National Cable and Broadband, my name is Rachel. How can I help?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I am so mad right now! Your technician missed the installation appointment for the second time today without any notice!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am genuinely sorry for that unacceptable delay. Let me check the field dispatch board immediately.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: The tech was stuck on an emergency line down, but I have rerouted a senior lead technician who is five minutes away, and applied a fifty dollar inconvenience credit to your bill.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Wait, really? He is five minutes away? Okay... I appreciate you stepping up and sorting this out.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: He just pulled into your driveway. I see him on GPS. Anything else I can assist with?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: No, that is great news. Thank you for fixing this promptly Rachel. Have a good afternoon.

ground_truth.reason: Agent dispatched immediate lead tech and applied billing credit, turning an angry customer into a satisfied one.

evidence.quote: rerouted a senior lead technician who is five minutes away, and applied a fifty dollar inconvenience credit

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Urban Apparel Returns, this is Marcus.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Good afternoon Marcus. I was hoping to return a winter jacket, but the 30-day return window passed two weeks ago.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hello there! Let me review the return authorization system... unfortunately, beyond 30 days the warehouse scanner rejects all return labels.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I completely understand Marcus. I should have tried it on earlier, that is on me. Thank you so much for looking into it for me.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you for understanding our policy. Have a lovely day ahead.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: You too, bye-bye.

ground_truth.reason: Customer politely requested late return which was blocked by warehouse policy.

evidence.quote: beyond 30 days the warehouse scanner rejects all return labels.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: PowerGrid Utility billing, officer Hernandez.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: You cut off my electricity yesterday even though my auto-pay is set up! My whole refrigerator of food spoiled!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am looking into this right now... our automated batch payment system had a glitch on Tuesday. I am remotely restoring power this second.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: The power is back, but who is going to pay for three hundred dollars of spoiled meat and dairy?!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I have credited two hundred and fifty dollars in emergency utility credits to compensate for the disruption.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That barely covers it! Your incompetence ruined my family's dinner. I am still furious that this happened and will be taking this up with the state utility board!

ground_truth.reason: Power was restored and utility credit issued, but customer remained furious over spoiled food.

evidence.quote: I am remotely restoring power this second.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: CloudDrive support, this is Leo.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Oh splendid, you guys just wiped my photo sync folder. Outstanding cloud architecture, truly state of the art.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am so sorry to hear that. Did the folder delete locally or from the web portal?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Both. Empty as a desert. I love paying fifty bucks a month for files to vanish into thin air.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I checked our server snapshot versioning. I have restored all forty-two hundred items from the 4 AM snapshot right now.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Well what do you know, they reappeared. Next time try not scaring people to death with your updates.

ground_truth.reason: Customer used sarcastic remarks about data loss, which agent resolved by restoring cloud snapshot.

evidence.quote: I have restored all forty-two hundred items from the 4 AM snapshot right now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Swift Airlines Reservation desk.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: My flight was delayed four hours! I will miss my connecting cruise!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Let me see if there is an earlier—

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I don't care about excuses, I need a flight that leaves by noon!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Looking at partner airlines—

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Book me on Delta or United, whatever it takes!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I have confirmed and booked you on the 11:15 AM non-stop on United, gate B12. Your boarding pass is in your inbox.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Oh. Wow, okay. That works. Thanks.

ground_truth.reason: Customer repeatedly interrupted agent before being successfully rebooked on partner airline.

evidence.quote: I have confirmed and booked you on the 11:15 AM non-stop on United

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Auto Insure claims desk, my name is Tina.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Tina, can I file a comprehensive claim for cosmetic rock chips on my front bumper?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Rock chips under one inch are classified as normal road wear and tear, which is not covered under the comprehensive policy terms.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Thanks for explaining that clearly Tina, I appreciate you saving me the hassle of paperwork. Have a good one.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: You are very welcome! Drive safely.

ground_truth.reason: Customer thanked the agent for explanation, but the insurance claim was not covered.

evidence.quote: normal road wear and tear, which is not covered under the comprehensive policy terms.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Rental Car customer relations, agent Todd.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: You charged me a three hundred dollar cleaning fee for dog hair when I don't even own a dog!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: The return branch uploaded inspection photos showing pet hair in the backseat. I cannot remove branch-level fees.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: You are lying or looking at the wrong vehicle! Transfer me to your supervisor right this second!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Please hold while I connect you to the supervisor escalation department.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I will wait, and your manager better fix this.

ground_truth.reason: Agent refused to waive branch cleaning fee, prompting customer to demand supervisor escalation.

evidence.quote: Transfer me to your supervisor right this second!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hurry up, I have a long queue.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Pardon? I just wanted to know if my deposit has cleared.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I don't care about your deposit. Check your mobile app instead of wasting my time.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: How dare you speak to me like that! What is your employee badge number?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Whatever, figure it out yourself.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I am speaking to corporate executive relations about you!

ground_truth.reason: Agent was hostile, telling customer to hurry up and refusing assistance.

evidence.quote: Hurry up, I have a long queue.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: BookStore Online, Samantha speaking.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Samantha, I was charged twice for order 654321.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I see the duplicate payment capture. I have voided the second charge and processed an immediate refund to your card.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I just received the refund email confirmation. Thank you so much!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Happy to help! Have a wonderful day.

ground_truth.reason: Agent voided duplicate payment and refunded customer immediately.

evidence.quote: I have voided the second charge and processed an immediate refund to your card.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Roadside assistance, dispatch desk.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Help, my tire blew out on highway 101 near mile marker... wait can you hear me?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Caller, which mile marker on 101?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: The line has dropped.

ground_truth.reason: Roadside emergency call dropped before mile marker or vehicle location could be confirmed.

evidence.quote: The line has dropped.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Cellular Network support, Greg here.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Greg, I got my new SIM card in the mail and need help activating it.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I can activate that for you right now. I just provisioned the ICCID on our network; please restart your phone.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Restarted and 5G signal bars popped up right away! Thank you so much Greg!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: You are all set! Welcome to our network.

ground_truth.reason: Agent activated new SIM card and customer verified cellular network connection.

evidence.quote: I just provisioned the ICCID on our network

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Health Benefits Authorization, agent Frank.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Why was my specialist MRI prior-authorization denied? My doctor said it was urgent!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: The medical review committee flagged that step therapy physical therapy notes were missing from the file.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I cannot walk without excruciating pain and you want physical therapy?! You people are heartless bureaucrats!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I understand your frustration, but without the therapy records I cannot approve the MRI.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I am appealing this to the state health commissioner.

ground_truth.reason: Prior authorization denied due to missing step therapy clinical notes.

evidence.quote: without the therapy records I cannot approve the MRI.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: FitLife Clubs member desk, Zoe speaking.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Zoe, I am traveling for two months and need to freeze my gym membership.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I have put a two-month administrative freeze on your account starting today. Zero billing until December.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Awesome, that was very smooth. Thank you Zoe!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Safe travels, see you in December!

ground_truth.reason: Agent placed a two-month freeze on gym membership.

evidence.quote: I have put a two-month administrative freeze on your account starting today.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: TrustBank Security hotline, agent Kyle.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Help! I just lost my wallet at the airport and my debit card is in it! Someone is going to steal my savings!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Take a deep breath, I have locked and frozen your debit card right now. No transactions can go through.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Oh thank goodness... did anyone try to use it yet?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Zero attempted charges. I also dispatched a rush replacement card to your hotel with overnight delivery.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: You are a lifesaver Kyle. I was panicking so much. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

ground_truth.reason: Agent immediately froze lost debit card and arranged overnight replacement to hotel.

evidence.quote: I have locked and frozen your debit card right now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Apex Hardware customer service.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi, I am calling about a prescription refill at the pharmacy counter.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: You have reached Apex Hardware tools, not Apex Pharmacy. I will transfer your call to the pharmacy line.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Oh silly me, thank you for transferring.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Connecting you now.

ground_truth.reason: Customer dialed hardware store instead of pharmacy; transferred without resolution.

evidence.quote: I will transfer your call to the pharmacy line.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Home Mortgage Lending, this is Scott.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Scott, has my loan application been approved yet? Closing date is in two weeks.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: The underwriter requested one additional tax schedule, which our system received yesterday. It is currently in the secondary review queue.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Does that mean it will be approved in time?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: It is in progress; underwriters take 48 to 72 hours. We cannot guarantee the outcome until the review finishes.

ground_truth.reason: Loan underwriting is actively in progress; outcome cannot be confirmed yet.

evidence.quote: We cannot guarantee the outcome until the review finishes.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: NetGear Tech Assistance, Andy here.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Andy, my wifi extender keeps flashing amber instead of solid green.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hold the WPS button on your router for five seconds, then press the pair button on the extender.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Doing that now... hey, it turned solid green and full speed internet connected in my backyard!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That is what we like to hear! Problem solved.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Thank you Andy, you made my day!

ground_truth.reason: Agent guided customer through WPS pairing, resolving flashing amber extender error.

evidence.quote: it turned solid green and full speed internet connected

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: LawnCare Replacement Parts, agent Keith.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I need a replacement carburetor diaphragm for mower model Pro-98.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I checked our warehouse database. Model Pro-98 was discontinued eight years ago and parts manufacturing has ceased.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So you are saying my three thousand dollar commercial mower is garbage now?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am afraid OEM parts are no longer available anywhere in our supply chain.

ground_truth.reason: Mower parts discontinued and no longer manufactured.

evidence.quote: OEM parts are no longer available anywhere in our supply chain.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Airport Baggage Services, agent Wendy.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: My luggage never showed up on the carousel! I have business meetings tomorrow and no suits!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I scanned your bag tag #554433. It was put on the direct flight right behind yours and lands in 45 minutes.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Our courier will deliver it directly to your hotel room tonight by 9 PM, free of charge.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Oh, that is such a huge relief! I was terrified it was lost in Europe. Thank you so much Wendy.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Rest easy, we will take care of getting it to your room.

ground_truth.reason: Agent tracked delayed bag on next flight and scheduled courier hotel delivery.

evidence.quote: Our courier will deliver it directly to your hotel room tonight by 9 PM, free of charge.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: PetBox Concierge, how can I help?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi! My golden retriever loved the duck chew toys in this month's box! Can I add extra chew toys to my recurring subscription?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That is adorable! I added the double-toy add-on to your recurring monthly delivery profile starting next box.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Fantastic! He will be so excited. Thank you so much!

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Give your dog a pet from us! Have a wonderful day.

ground_truth.reason: Customer happily added extra pet toys to subscription profile.

evidence.quote: I added the double-toy add-on to your recurring monthly delivery profile
